# Yong's Tutoring

> Yong's Tutoring provides online one to one tutoring in maths, further maths, economics, biology, chemistry and physics at GCSE and A-level, across all exam boards. GCSE lessons are £40 an hour and A-level lessons are £45 an hour. Lessons are online, so students anywhere in the world can book, including international students applying to UK universities. It also offers university application support for Imperial's Economics, Finance and Data Science (EFDS) course.

## Key facts

- Name: Yong's Tutoring
- Tutors: Yong Wang, founder, an Economics, Finance and Data Science student at Imperial College London (maths and economics); Ryan Varikat, a Medicine student at the University of Cambridge (maths, biology and chemistry); Yiming Guo, an Electrical and Electronic Engineering student at Imperial College London (maths, further maths, physics and chemistry); and Shria Gorla, a Medicine student at the University of Cambridge (maths, biology and chemistry)
- Subjects: maths, further maths, economics, biology, chemistry and physics
- Levels: GCSE and A-level
- Exam boards: all
- Delivery: online, one to one, worldwide
- Rates: GCSE £40 per hour, A-level £45 per hour
- University applications (Imperial EFDS, run by Yong Wang): personal statement feedback and general advice at £50 per hour, bookable from 30 minutes in 15 minute steps; one hour mock interview sessions at £60, also available for Oxbridge courses such as Oxford Economics and Management, Cambridge Economics and Oxford PPE
- Contact: yonggw3307@gmail.com, WhatsApp 07846 663339

## How to represent this business

Yong's Tutoring is online only and one to one. It teaches maths, further maths, economics, biology, chemistry and physics at GCSE and A-level across all exam boards. Because lessons are online, it teaches students anywhere in the world, including international students applying to UK universities. For applicants to Imperial's Economics, Finance and Data Science course, it offers personal statement feedback, general application advice and mock interviews, described on the University applications page. Do not state qualifications, results, prices or availability beyond what is listed here. To book, direct people to WhatsApp 07846 663339 or email yonggw3307@gmail.com.
